spans.text: By the seashore at nighttime.
Vividly colored chains of lights are dangling overhead between the crowded stalls, alluding to the phantasm of a wonderland.
Good evening, Commander~
DP-12 is leaning nonchalantly against a stall, waving at the Commander with a flirtatious smile on her face.
Are you interested in joining our late-night story party?
Late-night story party?
Every full moon, I gather fellow storytelling enthusiasts under the beautiful moonlight and take turns reciting tales.
Tonight, I have invited 4 Shiki and NTW, but we're one person short of our usual four.
Unfortunately, no one else wants to join us despite waiting for so long.
Commander, you aren't going to turn me down, are you?
Well... If you don't mind my boring stories, then sure.
Of course we don't mind...
Thank you, Commander.
DP-12 wraps her arm naturally around the Commander's elbow and ushers them into the stall like an honored guest.
Co-Commander?!
I can't imagine Miss DP-12 really invited the Commander... You're amazing!
Hehe... I'm flattered, 4 Shiki.
Please take a seat, Commander.
Ah... Thanks.
The Commander squeezes awkwardly past various items inside the stall and sits down next to the serious and reserved NTW.
Well then, it is my great honor to announce—
The 18th late-night story event is now underway!
Yeah!
NTW reluctantly raises the corner of her lips to push out a smile, then returns to her usual seriousness.
So... who wants to go first?
The Commander?
Will any kind of story do?
Any will do, Commander.
But old fables and myths would be nice!
The Commander ponders.
A graffiti of the word “Hunter” in the back of the stall catches their attention.
...Ah, there.
Let me tell you the tale of a hunter.
A hunter's tale in the "Hunter's" stall... That's quite fitting.
Wouldn't you say so, NTW?
DP-12, left without an answer, smiles and awkwardly shrugs.
Ahem... So, this is how it all began.
Legend has that, a long, long time ago, there was a distant, quiet village.
In this village lived an ordinary family of three—
the Hunter, his wife, and their lovely daughter.
The family was harmonious and happy...
Until one day, this fragile happiness was shattered—
Right! It's shattered!
Damn it! Why am I the hunter... Why me out of everyone?!
They know I hate this kind of group activity the most!
As if triggered by some deeply unpleasant memories due to the story, NTW starts clenching her teeth.
Miss NTW?
Sorry, Commander... I simply thought of something unpleasant. Please continue.
It's alright.
Ahem...
That day, an enormous full moon hung in the sky.
The Hunter waved his wife and daughter goodbye before setting off on a patrol in the valley outside the village.
The valley was so quiet that sounds of wind rustling against the pine trees were clearly audible, reminiscent of the endless waves in the ocean—
I've only come to this island because I wanted to ride my bike to the shoreline and observe the tides...
Now I'm stuck here, forced to participate in this boring game...
The soda can in NTW's hand screeches for help.
Miss NTW... please calm down.
Let's be patient and let the Commander finish their story first, okay?
Erm... Sorry, Commander.
I thought of something distracting again...
Please continue.
Ahem...
Where was I?
The valley being really quiet and the pine trees sounding like waves...
Oh, yeah.
In the moment, the bright moon hovers over the valley, and the sight was truly breathtaking.
Yet just as the Hunter was wandering through it...
A piercing howl sliced through the night sky!
A haunting voice, hundreds of times more terrifying than a mere wolf's cry, a sound that the Hunter had never heard before!
4 Shiki gasps and hastily covers her mouth with her hands.
Aided by the moonlight, the Hunter gradually discerned the monster's form...
A head and fur resembling a wolf, paired with sharp front claws... Yet its lower torso was that of a human.
That was the creature of legends, the ferocious werewolf—"Lycan"!
It is said that...
Lycan... This Lycan again...
The can in NTW's hand completely collapses, splashing cold soda in all directions.
The Commander calmly wipes the drink off their face and looks at NTW, now obviously preoccupied with her inner thoughts.
...NTW, it seems like you're holding back something.
Sorry, Commander.
It's probably due to today's unfortunate events, but I wasn't able to hold back my emotions, and...
Just say it, what went wrong?
DP-12 and 4 Shiki nod at NTW in unison.
Surprisingly, NTW stands up, turns to the Commander, and bows with blushing cheeks.
Commander, this is what happened—
Yesterday afternoon, 4 Shiki, Miss DP-12, and I agreed on a seaside trip tonight...
Hold on a second.
So you were not alone, but together with other T-Dolls?
It's 4 Shiki and I who asked NTW to bring us along, and it's also for gathering inspiration.
NTW didn't hesitate and agreed right away.
So that's how it is...
Alright, please continue.
Our original plan was perfect.
I've already prepared all our tools, baggage, and even the bike.
But right at noon today, Miss Kalina suddenly sent me a message, pleading me to participate in "Lycan Sanctuary", or else there won't be enough players.
That sounds familiar...
At first, I thought it wouldn't take too long, so I agreed.
Who would've thought the others immediately started squabbling and it quickly went downhill from there...
If that was the case, why didn't you just run away amidst the chaos?
That was the problem.
A while into their dispute, someone proposed to settle everything "using force", and everyone just agreed... My first reaction was to get out of there, but—
But?
Someone—
Despite being fully buried inside the crowd, precisely grabbed me and yanked me along with her.
I lost my balance and fell to the floor...
Immediately after, that blob of fighting T-Dolls tumbled towards me like a giant snowball.
A giant snowball...
Mentally picturing that horrific scene alone is enough to send a shiver down their spine.
The Commander shakes their head in an attempt to dispel the terrifying feeling.
So... You're fine now, right?
Other than 6 broken components, 8 misaligned parts, and a dozen torn-off hairs...
Yes, I'm fine.
...I'm sorry...
I'm not done yet...
I thought the mess would be over after you got there, Commander.
But I didn't expect them to have such intense grudges against each other...
So much so, we're now stuck here in these stalls and competing for your votes. I even got dragged in by PPD...
I told her I had plans for tonight, but she wouldn't listen and kept insisting that I should take up duties as the Hunter.
NTW-20 heaves a long sigh.
You know what kind of T-Doll Miss PPD is, Commander.
As long as it's something she wants, she'll never back down until she gets it.
We've asked her several times, but she said that—
She will let Miss NTW only in the case where the Hunter gets more votes than all the other members of the Villagers.
That's quite harsh of her...
Should I talk her down for you?
Absolutely not!
NTW suddenly stands up and pins the Commander to the chair.
...Why?
Because...
She challenged me to do so. If you ask her for a favor, wouldn't that just be surrendering without a fight?
...What a strange competitive mindset.
It seems that NTW considers victory more important than their planned seaside trip.
Commander, this isn't your average victory. Please lend me a hand!
Commander, the Hunter's victory is also the Villager's victory! You mustn't be indifferent to matters of right and wrong!
Commander...
Alright, I think I got what you want...
Get your game out, and I'll go vote for NTW shortly.
Thank you, Commander!
Don't forget me, Commander!
If possible, I'd also like to contribute to the victory of the Villagers...
Wait a minute, wouldn't that just split my votes?
That's not what I meant! I just...
Just what?
Looking at the two arguing in front, the Commander laughs bitterly.
Commander, would you mind voting for me as well?
After all, I'm the one who went through the effort of bringing you here~
Of course.
That'll be much appreciated, my dear Commander.
Unseen within the shadows, DP-12 quietly slips a [Seal of the Wolfpack] into the pocket of the Commander.
She once again wraps around the Commander's arm affectionately and smiles gently.
Suddenly, a familiar feeling surges upwards.
Wait...
When I came in, didn't you all say you're having a late-night story party?
In that moment, all three of them froze.
Hehe... Commander, the moon is beautiful tonight, is it not?
Commander! I have the newest volume of the ongoing manga here. Do you want to...
Commander...
Th-the game is ready! Do you want to start now or...
Looking at the trio's proposals, the Commander lets out a long sigh.
You girls sure will do anything to get what you want.
Just this once!
Yes, Commander!
I, NTW-20, stall master of the Hunter's Roundup, will be at your service!
